audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart was blanket 'Skill'; content win[] and packet levelChart both give Annie stages 1-6 (through Level 6) and Sylas from first item on.
audit.why: Pyromania point-and-click stun plus mana-refunding Q bully a dashless early Sylas; Flash-Tibbers out-bursts the 6 all-in; first item plus Kingslayer sustain flip it once the stun stack isn't full.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content/packet, whys rewritten to match the verdicts.

audit.why: Spikes coherent: Annie 3-5 stun-stack zoning, Annie 6 (Flash-Tibbers), Sylas first item, Sylas late brawl — matches content.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digit; Tibbers' 130s cooldown and Q's 4s never stated; Molten Shield's thorns absent everywhere.
audit.why: Kit: Q flat 4s, W flat 7s, E 10s with damage-return on attackers, R 130/115/100s. Sylas' whole pattern is spell-then-auto whirls — Annie's E punishing 'attacks or spells' is directly relevant to the brawl string.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns; Molten Shield thorns folded into dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: - Annie Summon: Tibbers: matchup-defining — Flash-Tibbers off a stocked passive stun is her whole threat — watch the glow under her feet. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Abscond (shield-dash) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Summon: Tibbers is 130/115/100s — Flash-Tibbers off a stocked stun is her whole threat; watch the glow under her feet. - Her Q is a flat 4s and W a flat 7s, so poke never stops: the counting that matters is her four-spell stun stack. - Your Hijack cycles at 80/55/30s.
